Peach gum swells 10x so go bigger than you think. Fridge, overnight. ON THE DAY 	1.	Drain the peach gum. Pick out any dark bark or grit. Rinse. 	2.	Soak lily bulb in cold water, fridge, 1 ~ 2 hours. 	3.	🔺Soak snow fungus cold water 30 ~ 1 hour NEVER leave in room temperature to soak overnight (can be dangerous!)  	4.	Cut the hard yellow core off the fungus. Tear the frills small. 	5.	Peel, core and quarter the pears. 	6.	Pot: peach gum, Job’s tears, snow fungus, pear, red dates, longan. Cover with water. 	7.	Boil, then lowest simmer, lid on, 1 hour. Stir every 20 mins so the Job’s tears don’t catch. 	8.	Add lily bulb. Chrysanthemum in a tea strainer. Simmer 8 mins, then lift the flowers out. 	9.	Off the heat: salt, goji, Manuka honey. Taste. More honey if you want. 	10.	Warm or chilled. It sets thicker overnight
